title: Annett's Mono Village Campground

services.name: Camp Sites
services.desc: Our Entire Campground (Both Hook-up & Dry camp sites) is operated on a “first-come, first-served” basis. There are NO reservations taken on ANY of our campground sites. There is a maximum of eight persons per site. That includes children and infants. Electric Vehicle and e-bike charging is not allowed. Water, sewer, and electricity. $45 per day for 2 people, plus tax, $3 per day for each additional person. There is a .50c per day pet fee (Up to 2 pets) for all dry and hook up sites. Monthly rate is $15.00; Seasonal rate is $75.00. Please Be Advised: Our resort, as well as the surrounding areas, are home to multiple types of wildlife, including bears. blurb: Mono Village, located on Upper Twin Lake, is a fishermen’s haven and family vacation hideaway. Nestled in one of the most scenic and rugged areas in the Eastern Sierras, Mono Village rests at an elevation of 7,100 feet and is easily reached from Bridgeport, California. To find us, take Twin Lakes Road out of Bridgeport. Follow 14 miles to the very end of the pavement.
